channel.title: Breach updates
channel.description: Signed Breach releases for Apple Silicon

item.title: 0.4 Build #27
item.description:
Breach 0.4 Beta

Settings → About → Open Third-Party Notices now opens a resizable Breach window. The text supports selection and copying, and the window follows your appearance setting.

Subscriptions now update automatically every hour by default. Your saved on/off choice and interval are preserved. Change either in Settings → Subscriptions.

The Profiles actions arrow has more space beside the three dots and rotates up while the menu is open. It stays aligned with the dots and rotates back down when the menu closes.

Settings sidebar icons now follow your chosen accent color immediately in light and dark appearance.

The map remembers your selected departure city when you reopen the map or restart Breach.

Settings → Updates now shows a Stable/Beta selector after confirmed beta opt-in. The selector stays available after switching to Stable and restarting Breach. Existing Beta users get it automatically.

Software updates reinstall an existing network helper after relaunch and verify it before restoring your connection. macOS asks for administrator permission to authorize the updated helper.

If authorization is declined or helper verification fails, Breach stays disconnected and opens Settings → Permissions to retry. Updates also replace the helper when Breach was disconnected, and keep it uninstalled if it was not present before the update.

The network helper controls System Proxy and Enhanced Mode. It accepts only the updated signed app and its bundled command-line tool.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.

item.title: 0.3 Build #20
item.description:
Breach 0.3

Dashboard now opens in a smaller 1040 × 720 point window and can shrink to an 840 × 560 point content area. The toolbar and sidebar remain available, and dense pages scroll at smaller sizes.

Settings now opens in a separate native Mac window with a Liquid Glass sidebar and grouped controls. App preferences save immediately, and Command-comma reopens the last pane used in the current session.

General, Network, DNS, TUN and Sniffer configuration have moved from Dashboard into Settings. The Breach application menu has one Settings command with a gear icon. Duplicate headings and the Settings sidebar toggle have been removed.

Accent color swatches match their names. Clicking the Breach logo in the main sidebar opens Dashboard's Overview page. The Breach application menu responds promptly when opening or returning to the app.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.

item.title: 0.2.1 Build #17
item.description:
Breach 0.2.1

Fixes selective routing failures after extended use. Fake-IP DNS mappings now survive unrelated DNS lookups and engine restarts, so applications can continue using cached addresses.

Breach retains these routing mappings in a private local cache. Redir-host mode and disabled DNS keep their existing behavior.

Settings opens in its own native Mac window with a Liquid Glass sidebar, grouped controls and automatic saving. Command-comma reopens the last pane used in the current session.

Clicking the Breach logo at the top of the sidebar returns to Dashboard's Overview page.

This build uses ad-hoc code signing and is not Apple-notarized. Sparkle verifies the feed and download using Breach's existing Ed25519 signing key.
